resources.string: Turn your screen into a light.
The flash uses battery and can get warm. Turn it off when you\'re done.
The light stays on only while this screen is open and PocketGizmo is in front. It stops if you go back, lock the phone, or switch apps.
This device doesn\'t have a rear flash PocketGizmo can use. You can still turn your screen into a light.
Another app is using the camera. Close it and try again.
The flash isn\'t available right now. Try again.
PocketGizmo needs camera access to switch the flash on and off. Other tools still work without it.
Camera access was denied. You can enable it in system settings.
Flashes the Morse pattern ... --- ... again and again.
Start SOS flashing? This only flashes your light. It does not call, message, or send your location.
Flashing lights can affect some people. Stop if it feels uncomfortable.
This only flashes your light. It does not call, message, or send your location.
SOS stops immediately if you leave this screen, lock the phone, or switch apps. It never restarts by itself.
SOS light needs a rear flash. Screen Light can still brighten your screen.
Brightness only changes this screen while PocketGizmo is open. Your phone\'s brightness setting is not changed.
Magnetic accuracy is low. Move away from metal or magnets.
If the reading drifts, move your phone in a slow figure 8.
Magnets, metal and electronics can affect readings. This is not for safety-critical navigation.
This device doesn\'t have the orientation sensors PocketGizmo needs.
A surface counts as level when both readings are within 1°.
Calibrate on a surface you know is flat. Reset brings back the phone\'s raw readings.
Readings are approximate and depend on your phone\'s sensors, shape and case.
This device doesn\'t have the motion sensor PocketGizmo needs.
No laps yet. Tap Lap while the timer runs.
This clears the elapsed time and all laps.
Running counts up until you pause. A paused timer keeps its time and stays stopped until you resume. It keeps counting if you rotate the phone or leave this screen.
Your phone restarted, so the timer was stopped. Your saved time is still here.
Play a soft click when you tap.
A short vibration when you tap, when your phone supports it.
Screen Light may keep the display on while its screen is open.
Settings and stopwatch records stay on this phone. There is no account, cloud sync or backup.
Restores theme, sound, haptics, Screen Light and level calibration defaults. Stopwatch records are kept.
This restores the default settings and clears level calibration. Your stopwatch session and laps are not deleted.
Deletes the saved stopwatch session and laps.
This permanently deletes the saved stopwatch session and all laps.
PocketGizmo has no accounts, ads, analytics or internet access. Every tool runs on your phone.
Settings and stopwatch records are stored on this phone only. Cloud backup and device transfer are turned off. Uninstalling PocketGizmo or clearing its data removes them.
Compass and Level use your phone\'s sensors. Magnets, metal and cases can affect readings, and readings are approximate. They are not for safety-critical navigation.
Torch and SOS control the flash only while their screen is open and PocketGizmo is in front. The light stops when you leave the screen, lock the phone, or switch apps.
SOS only flashes a visual pattern. It does not call, message or share your location, and it is not a substitute for contacting emergency services.
Camera access is requested only for the flash tools. PocketGizmo does not use location, microphone, contacts, storage or notifications.
